anchors.name: sota_ref_d5
anchors.derivation: Cohn table lower bound for dimension 5 (achieved by the D5 root system among other constructions); independently corroborated via H. Cohn, A. Rajagopal, "Variations on five-dimensional sphere packings," arXiv:2412.00937, which presents a fourth construction reaching the same value but does not improve it. The exact kissing number in dimension 5 remains unknown (upper bound 44, Levenshtein 1979).

anchors.name: sota_ref_d6
anchors.derivation: Cohn table lower bound for dimension 6, achieved by the E6 root system (A. Korkine, G. Zolotareff, 1873). The exact kissing number in dimension 6 remains unknown (upper bound 77, de Laat, Leijenhorst, de Muinck Keizer, arXiv:2404.18794, via exact semidefinite programming).
